summary: Appian Corp filed an 8-K under Items 2.02 and 8.01, reporting Q1 2026 results and announcing a board-authorized share repurchase program of up to $50 million, effective May 2026 through February 2028. The program allows repurchases via open market, privately negotiated transactions, Rule 10b5-1 plans, or accelerated share repurchases, with timing and amount dependent on liquidity, market conditions, and other factors. No specific price per share, premium, or advisor was named. Watch for execution pace and potential impact on liquidity or earnings per share.
